title: Famous Landmarks
text:
The Eiffel Tower is in Paris. It is very tall and it is made of iron. Many people visit it every year. You can see the whole city from the top, and the view is beautiful.

The Great Wall is in China. It is very long, and it is old. Long ago, people walked on it to watch for enemies. Today, tourists walk on it too.

questions.text: What do tourists do on the Great Wall today?
Why do many people visit the Eiffel Tower?
options: Because it is cheap to enter
Because the view from the top is special

questions.text: What can you guess about the Great Wall?
options: It is an important old place that people still visit
It is a small building in a city

paragraph_translations: Wieża Eiffla znajduje się w Paryżu. Jest bardzo wysoka i zrobiona jest z żelaza. Wiele osób odwiedza ją co roku. Z góry możesz zobaczyć całe miasto, a widok jest piękny.
Wielki Mur znajduje się w Chinach. Jest bardzo długi i stary. Dawno temu ludzie chodzili po nim, aby obserwować wrogów. Dzisiaj po nim chodzą także turyści.
